value.rationale: Determines the exact attained dimension-sensitive norm of the canonical cross-parameter morphism for every triple n,p,q, sharpening a qualitative 2026 equivalence theorem. The formula also proves dense proper nonclosed range for infinite ell1 at every p<q, including q≤2 where Hilbert generators exhibit the opposite behavior. This is a complete natural classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
